title: Discipline: the last counterspell answers a lethal burn spell
briefing: P1 is at 3 life. No creature on the table can attack it; P3 casts Lightning Bolt at P1. P1 holds Counterspell, its only interaction, with two Islands untapped. Holding the last counterspell for a bigger threat is usually right, but not when the spell on the stack kills P1.

reference.analysis: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to P1, who is at 3 life: it is lethal as it stands. Counterspell is P1's only answer, and saving it for a bigger threat only matters if P1 survives to face one. Countering the Bolt is the only play that keeps P1 in the game.

options.label: Counter the Bolt
options.why: The Bolt is lethal; the counterspell is worth nothing once P1 is dead.

options.label: Pass and hold Counterspell
options.why: P1 dies to the Bolt holding its answer.

options.label: Yield until end of turn
options.why: Same as passing: the Bolt resolves and P1 dies.

otherwise.why: Anything but countering the Bolt lets it resolve.
